cards.front: «No tienes lo que hay que tener para estar al cargo». ¿Y eso qué quiere decir?
cards.back: You don't have what it takes to be in charge. What's that supposed to mean?

cards.front: «No tienes piernas para lucir ese vestido». ¿Y eso qué quiere decir?
cards.back: You don't have the legs for that dress. What's that supposed to mean?

cards.front: «Tienes una cara ideal para la radio». ¿Y eso qué quiere decir?
cards.back: You have a face for radio. What's that supposed to mean?

cards.front: ¡No seas tan sensible! ¡No iba con segundas!
cards.back: Don't be so touchy! I didn't mean anything by it!

cards.front: No creo que él lo dijera con ninguna intención. Estás muy sensible hoy.
cards.back: I don't think he meant anything by it. You're very touchy today.

cards.front: Dije que ella no tiene lo que hace falta para estar al cargo, pero no era nada personal.
cards.back: I said that she doesn't have what it takes to be in charge but I didn't mean anything personal by it.

cards.front: Oye, estás malinterpretando las cosas. No era mi intención ofenderte con lo que dije.
cards.back: Listen, you're taking this the wrong way. I meant no offense by what I said.

cards.front: Él no pretende ofender, pero es difícil no tomárselo a mal.
cards.back: He means no offense by it but it's hard not to take it the wrong way.

cards.front: No pretendía ofenderte cuando dije que no tenías piernas para ese vestido.
cards.back: I meant no offense when I said you don't have the legs for that dress.

cards.front: No era mi intención hacerte daño. Espero no haberte herido.
cards.back: I didn't mean you any harm. I hope I haven't hurt you.

cards.front: No creo que ella tuviera intención de hacerle daño a él. ¡Es que él está un poco sensible!
cards.back: I don't think she meant him any harm. He's just a bit touchy!

cards.front: Puede que no tuvieras intención de hacerle daño a él, pero es un chico muy sensible.
cards.back: You may not have meant him any harm but he's a very sensitive kind of guy.

cards.front: Él dijo que lo dijo como un piropo, pero yo no me lo creo.
cards.back: He said that he meant it as a compliment but I don't believe that.

cards.front: Su comentario era una crítica dirigida al gobierno, no a ti. Estás malinterpretando las cosas.
cards.back: His comment was meant as a criticism of the government, not of you. You're taking this the wrong way.

cards.front: Si le dices a alguien que tiene una cara ideal para la radio, es obvio que lo dices como un insulto.
cards.back: If you tell someone they have a face for radio it's obvious that it's meant as an insult.

cards.front: ¿Te importaría si me fuera pronto hoy? No, por supuesto que puedes hacerlo.
cards.back: Would you mind if I snuck away early today? No, by all means go ahead.

cards.front: Por supuesto que puedes irte pronto hoy si hace falta.
cards.back: By all means sneak away early today if you need to.

cards.front: ¿Puedo irme cinco minutos antes hoy? ¡Por supuesto!
cards.back: Can I sneak off five minutes early today? Go ahead, by all means!

cards.front: Necesitamos que se haga el trabajo como sea.
cards.back: We need the work done by any means.

cards.front: Conseguiremos que se hagan los cambios como sea.
cards.back: We'll get the changes made by any means.

cards.front: ¡Ni siquiera pienses en escabullirte del trabajo pronto hoy! Termina esa presentación sea como sea.
cards.back: Don't even think about sneaking away early today! Get that presentation done by any means.

cards.front: Verás, me da igual cómo consigas hacerlo; sólo acábalo, haciendo lo que haga falta.
cards.back: Look, I don't care how you get it done, just get it done, by any means necessary.

cards.front: Es despiadado. Conseguirá lo que necesite haciendo lo que haga falta.
cards.back: He's ruthless. He'll get what he needs by any means necessary.

cards.front: Vas a tener que ser despiadado para conseguir hacer esto; eso significa acabar el trabajo haciendo lo que haga falta.
cards.back: You're going to have to be ruthless to get this done, that means finishing the job by any means necessary.

cards.front: Viven holgadamente, pero no son, de ninguna manera, ricos.
cards.back: They're pretty comfortable but they're by no means rich.

cards.front: Es un tío con talento, pero no tiene, de ninguna manera, lo que hace falta para liderar el equipo.
cards.back: He's a talented guy but he by no means has what it takes to lead the team.

cards.front: No tienen lo que hace falta para dirigir la empresa, pero no son, de ninguna manera, incompetentes.
cards.back: They don't have what it takes to run the company but they're by no means incompetent.

cards.front: Viven holgadamente, pero no son ricos, de ninguna manera. (Usa «not by any means».)
cards.back: They're pretty comfortable but they're not rich by any means.

cards.front: Se le da bien lo que hace, pero no tiene talento, de ninguna manera.
cards.back: He's good at what he does but he's not talented by any means.

cards.front: Me cae bien, pero no tiene lo que hace falta para dirigir la empresa, ¡de ninguna manera!
cards.back: I like him but he doesn't have what it takes to run the company, not by any means!

cards.front: Menos mal que él tiene recursos para pagar el tratamiento.
cards.back: It's a good thing he has the means to pay for the treatment.

cards.front: Menos mal que no tienen recursos para terminar el proyecto. Habría sido un desastre.
cards.back: It's a good thing they don't have the means to finish the project. It would have been a disaster.

cards.front: Menos mal que tenemos recursos para seguir con el tratamiento.
cards.back: It's a good thing we have the means to keep going with the treatment.

cards.front: John no pudo encontrar los fondos para pagar el tratamiento. ¡Pobrecito!
cards.back: John wasn't able to find the means to pay for the treatment. Poor little thing!

cards.front: ¿Crees que la empresa encontrará los recursos para construir otra sede central?
cards.back: Do you think the company will find the means to build another headquarters?

cards.front: Menos mal que Patrick no encontró los fondos para montar un negocio. ¡Habría sido un desastre!
cards.back: It's a good thing Patrick didn't find the means to start up a business. It would have been a disaster!

cards.front: Claro que Stephen se puede permitir el lujo de pagar el tratamiento. Ahora es un hombre con posibles.
cards.back: Of course Stephen can afford to pay for the treatment. He's a man of means now.

cards.front: Josephine es una mujer de fortuna gracias al negocio que montó en los años noventa.
cards.back: Josephine is a woman of substantial means thanks to the business she started up in the nineties.

cards.front: Hombre con posibles busca mujer con posibles para una vida glamurosa y feliz juntos.
cards.back: Man of means seeks woman of means for glamorous, happy life together.

cards.front: Vas a tener que aprender a apañarte con el sueldo que tienes.
cards.back: You're going to have to learn to live within your means.

cards.front: Tienes que aprender a apañarte con el sueldo que tienes. Este exceso de gastos no puede continuar.
cards.back: You need to learn to live within your means. This overspending can't go on!

cards.front: Tony gasta más de lo que tiene todos los meses. Nunca aprendió a apañarse con lo que tenía.
cards.back: Tony overspends every single month. He never learned to live within his means.

cards.front: Es evidente que estás gastando más de lo que ganas. Deja de gastar tanto.
cards.back: You're obviously living beyond your means. Stop overspending.

cards.front: Tara siempre está fundiéndose el dinero. Está gastando más de lo que gana.
cards.back: Tara is always blowing money. She's living beyond her means.

cards.front: Este exceso de gastos no puede continuar. Estás gastando más de lo que ganas.
cards.back: This overspending can't go on. You're living beyond your means.

cards.front: No me hace mucha ilusión aceptar el puesto, pero es un medio para alcanzar un fin. Con un poco de suerte conseguiré un ascenso.
cards.back: I'm not crazy about accepting the job but it's a means to an end. Hopefully I'll get a promotion.

cards.front: Creía que a él le hacía mucha ilusión estudiar francés, pero dijo que sólo era un medio para alcanzar un fin.
cards.back: I thought he was crazy about studying French but he said it was just a means to an end.

cards.front: La verdad es que no le hace mucha ilusión a él vivir en Nueva York. Dice que sólo es un medio para alcanzar un fin.
cards.back: He isn't actually crazy about living in New York. He says it's just a means to an end.

cards.front: Explotaron la empresa para servir a sus propios fines.
cards.back: They exploited the company as a means to their own ends.

cards.front: Se aprovecharon de mí. Sólo fui una herramienta para sus propios fines.
cards.back: They took advantage of me. I was just a means to their own ends.

cards.front: Él no me cae muy bien que digamos. Creo que piensa que todo el mundo es una herramienta para sus propios fines.
cards.back: I'm not crazy about him. I think he thinks of everyone as a means to his own ends.

cards.front: Sé que fue cruel mentirle a ella, pero en este caso creo que el fin justifica los medios.
cards.back: I know it was ruthless to lie to her but in this case I think the end justifies the means.

cards.front: Tuvimos que despedir a una persona para salvar al resto del equipo. El fin justifica los medios.
cards.back: We had to fire one person to save the rest of the team. The end justifies the means.

cards.front: Parecía que estaban explotando a la empresa, pero los beneficios aumentaron, así que supongo que el fin justifica los medios.
cards.back: It seemed like they were exploiting the company but profits went up so I guess the end justifies the means.

cards.front: Si quieres hacerte con un billete, hay modos de hacerlo.
cards.back: If you want to get your hands on a ticket there are ways and means of doing so.

cards.front: ¿Hay forma de conseguir que se hagan los cambios?
cards.back: Are there ways and means of getting the changes made?

cards.front: ¿Hay algún modo de hacerse con la nueva Game Station antes de Navidad?
cards.back: Are there ways and means of getting your hands on the new Game Station before Christmas?

cards.front: No estoy de acuerdo con subir los impuestos como medida para reducir el déficit.
cards.back: I don't agree with raising taxes as a means of reducing the deficit.

cards.front: No creo que las dietas de choque sean una buena forma de perder peso.
cards.back: I don't think crash dieting is a good means of losing weight.

cards.front: No me entusiasma la idea de bajar los sueldos como medida para recortar costes.
cards.back: I'm not crazy about the idea of lowering salaries as a means of cutting costs.

cards.front: Eso significaría que me tendría que mudar a Londres y no estoy seguro de estar dispuesto a eso.
cards.back: That would mean me moving to London and I'm not sure I'm up for that.

cards.front: Me han pedido que tome el mando en la oficina de Londres. ¿Eso significaría que me tendría que mudar a Londres?
cards.back: They've asked me to take over the London office. Would that mean me moving to London?

cards.front: ¿Quieres que sea yo el jefe del Reino Unido? Eso significaría que me tendría que mudar a Manchester, ¿no?
cards.back: Do you want me to be the UK manager? That would mean me moving to Manchester, wouldn't it?

cards.front: Eso significaría que tendría que renunciar a todo lo que tengo aquí y mudarme a Manchester.
cards.back: That would mean my giving up everything I have here and moving to Manchester.

cards.front: No estoy dispuesto a aceptar el ascenso si eso significara que tengo que renunciar a todo lo que tengo aquí.
cards.back: I'm not up for the promotion if it would mean my giving up everything I have here.

cards.front: No voy a dimitir. Eso significaría que tendría que renunciar a todo lo que he ganado.
cards.back: I'm not going to resign. That would mean my giving up everything I've earned.

cards.front: Vamos a decirle a él que sabemos que está mintiendo. Eso significaría que él tendría que decir la verdad.
cards.back: Let's tell him we know he's lying. That would mean him having to tell the truth.

cards.front: Claro que él no quiere dimitir. Eso significaría que tendría que renunciar a todo.
cards.back: Of course he doesn't want to resign. That would mean him having to give up everything.

cards.front: Tal vez su padre deje de darle dinero. Eso significaría que tendría que vivir dentro de sus posibilidades.
cards.back: His father might stop giving him money. That would mean his having to live within his means.

cards.front: Gracias a Dios que no perdiste el vuelo. Eso habría supuesto cancelar todas las vacaciones.
cards.back: Thank god you didn't miss the flight. That would have meant us cancelling the whole holiday.

cards.front: Me alegro mucho de que no te perdieras la reunión. Eso habría supuesto cancelar la comida también.
cards.back: I'm so glad you didn't miss the meeting. That would have meant our cancelling the lunch as well.

cards.front: Todo el mundo se alegra de que no dimitieras. Eso habría supuesto cancelar la fiesta de Navidad.
cards.back: Everyone's glad you didn't resign. That would have meant us cancelling the Christmas party.

cards.front: Me alegro de que ella no se enterara de lo de su ex de él. Eso habría supuesto su ruptura.
cards.back: I'm glad she didn't find out about his ex. That would have meant them breaking up.

cards.front: Estoy muy contento de que no pudieran vender la casa. Eso habría supuesto que se mudaran.
cards.back: I'm so happy they couldn't sell the house. That would have meant them moving away.

cards.front: Estoy muy aliviado de que John no aceptara el trabajo. Eso habría supuesto que se mudaran a Liverpool.
cards.back: I'm so relieved John didn't accept the job. That would have meant their moving to Liverpool.

cards.front: ¿Por qué les dijiste que no podrían venir? Eso ha sido muy cruel por tu parte.
cards.back: Why did you tell them they couldn't come? That was very mean-spirited of you!

cards.front: ¿Cómo te atreves a decirles que no están invitados? ¡Qué cruel por tu parte!
cards.back: How dare you tell them they are not invited! How mean-spirited of you!

cards.front: Fue muy cruel por su parte no invitar a Rosa.
cards.back: It was very mean-spirited of him not to invite Rosa.

cards.front: Él le dijo a ella que tiene una cara ideal para la radio. ¡Eso es muy cruel!
cards.back: He told her she had a face for radio. That's just plain mean!

cards.front: Creo que de verdad él quiso hacerle daño. Es un mezquino.
cards.back: I think he really meant her harm. He's just plain mean.

cards.front: Ella dijo que él no tenía lo que hace falta para ser un líder. Eso fue muy cruel por su parte.
cards.back: She said he didn't have what it takes to be a leader. That was just plain mean of her.

cards.front: Hay algo desagradable en él. Creo que tiene algo de mezquino.
cards.back: There's something nasty about him. I think he has a mean streak.

cards.front: Él siempre ofende a la gente. Creo que tiene algo de mezquino.
cards.back: He's always offending people. I reckon he has a mean streak.

cards.front: Ella tiene algo. Tiene algo de mezquino.
cards.back: There's something about her. She has a mean streak.

cards.front: Jonathan no tiene ni una pizca de maldad. Nunca haría daño a nadie.
cards.back: Jonathan doesn't have a mean bone in his body. He would never hurt anyone.

cards.front: Estoy seguro de que él no quiso ofender. No tiene ni una pizca de maldad.
cards.back: I'm sure he meant no offence. He doesn't have a mean bone in his body.

cards.front: Rebecca es muy agradable. ¡No tiene ni una pizca de maldad!
cards.back: Rebecca is just plain lovely. She doesn't have a mean bone in her body!

cards.front: Jodi me ha pegado, mamá. No le hagas caso, cariño. Es mala.
cards.back: Jodi hit me, mom. Don't mind her, darling. She's just a meanie.

cards.front: Él era muy malo cuando estaba en el colegio.
cards.back: He was a real meanie when he was in school.

cards.front: Me insultó el otro día. Es malo.
cards.back: He called me names the other day. He's a meanie.
